hints.title: Diagonal Traversal Starting Points
hints.text: Start the segment from cells containing value 1 and proceed along diagonal paths.

hints.title: Parity Alternation and Direction State
hints.text: The expected values alternate between 2 and 0 after the initial 1. Track whether a clockwise 90 degree turn has already occurred.

hints.title: Clockwise Turning Transitions
hints.text: Use dynamic programming with state (r, c, direction, turned, expected_value). A clockwise turn from direction d shifts the direction index to (d + 1) mod 4.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of rows in the grid
m: number of columns in the grid
complexity.notes: Each cell has 4 diagonal directions, 2 turn flags, and 2 target values in memoized search.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive exploration without memoization traverses exponentially many redundant paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing (r, c, direction, turned, target) avoids recomputing overlapping path tails.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the state space, model 90 degree clockwise turns cleanly via modular arithmetic, and memoize transitions.
